name: Stormbringer: Charge grants 30% haste for the next casted spell only (#13376)
contract: Charge 804826 reads 'Charge yourself with electricity, generating 100 Static and increasing your spell
haste by 30% for your next cast. Lasts 10 sec.' and carries no GCD (StartRecoveryCategory 0,
StartRecoveryTime 0, CastingTimeIndex 1). Previously 804826 had no proc or cast-consumption hook, so
its +30% SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS buff stayed active for the entire 10-second duration across multiple
casted spells instead of dropping after the next casted spell completes.
Live CoA logs (518 casts across 30 logs) confirm instant spells (Volt, Cloudburst, Conjure Storm,
Storm Ascendance) do not consume Charge, while the next completed cast-time spell removes it.
A level-80 Stormbringer casts Charge, immediately casts instant Volt 500928 (proving Charge
triggers no GCD and instant casts keep Charge active), then casts Brine 807105 (base cast time 2000 ms,
hasted to 1538 ms by Charge). Once Brine completes (well inside the 10-second duration), Charge must
be removed and Brine's cast time must return to its unhasted baseline.

steps.label: BASELINE: Brine base cast time is 2000 ms before Charge
SETUP: Charge reduces Brine cast time by 30% haste (2000 -> 1538 ms)
Immediately cast instant Volt 500928 with no GCD wait
CONTROL: Volt cast succeeded immediately after off-GCD Charge
CONTROL: Instant Volt does not consume Charge
Wait for Volt GCD to clear
Cast hasted Brine 807105 (1538 ms cast time)
SETUP: Brine cast completed well within Charge's 10-second duration
DISCRIMINATING: Completing Brine consumes Charge before its 10-second timer expires
DISCRIMINATING: Brine cast time returns to 2000 ms for subsequent casts
